text_to_embed: Table: vendor. Description: Profile data for warehouse suppliers and vendors. Contains agreement codes, supplier profiles, and locations. Common keywords: vendor name, supplier state, country, big or small vendor type, creation date, agreement number.

columns.name: vendor_agreement_number
columns.description: Primary agreement identifier for the vendor contract.

columns.name: vendor_number
columns.description: Internal business identifier for the vendor entity.

columns.name: agreement_create_date
columns.description: The date when the vendor agreement record was initialized.

columns.name: vendor_name
columns.description: Legal business trading name of the vendor company.

columns.name: vendor_addr_country
columns.description: The country where the vendor headquarters are located.

columns.name: vendor_addr_state
columns.description: The operational state or region code for the vendor address.

columns.name: vendor_type
columns.description: Size category grouping. Restricted values: 'big' or 'small'.

columns.name: update_timestamp
columns.description: Audit record tracking when this vendor line was last modified.

columns.name: update_userid
columns.description: The user credentials identifier of the person updating the row.

text_to_embed: Table: agreement. Description: Tracks formal warehouse logistics contract lifecycles, operational states, and active timelines. Common keywords: contract type, status, effective date, expiration date, number of active items, agreement profile.

columns.name: vendor_agreement_number
columns.description: Foreign key reference linking directly to the parent vendor profile.

columns.name: agreement_type
columns.description: Part of the primary key. Categorizes the nature of the operational agreement.

columns.name: agreement_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status phase of the contract (e.g., Active, Suspended).

columns.name: agreement_eff_date
columns.description: The activation or effective start date of the legal agreement parameters.

columns.name: agreement_exp_date
columns.description: The absolute expiration boundary date for the agreement framework.

columns.name: number_of_items
columns.description: The total volume quantity cap of product stock items registered under this text block.

columns.name: last_updated_by
columns.description: System operator user signature mapping who last processed changes.

columns.name: update_timestamp
columns.description: System tracking clock recording the timing of modification writes.

text_to_embed: Table: purchase_details. Description: Logs discrete purchase transaction metadata, batch invoicing records, and tracking metrics. Common keywords: purchase id, order type, transaction date, last update date, items count per invoice batch.

columns.name: vendor_agreement_number
columns.description: Link key referencing the associated master vendor contract account.

columns.name: purchase_id
columns.description: Unique purchase transaction tracking identifier instance.

columns.name: purchase_type
columns.description: The operational type indicator classification assigned to this purchase event.

columns.name: purchase_date
columns.description: The baseline execution tracking date when the transaction record occurred.

columns.name: purchase_update_date
columns.description: The historical tracking marker logging follow-up transaction adjustments.

columns.name: number_of_items
columns.description: The net operational product quantity count bundled into this purchase transaction entry.

columns.name: last_updated_by
columns.description: Audit system identity trace mapping who saved the invoice line updates.

columns.name: update_timestamp
columns.description: Database system clock monitoring specific modification entry instances.

text_to_embed: Table: item_receiving_details. Description: Stores physical product unit counts, costs, and premium brokerage parameters. Common keywords: item number, sku cost, units ordered, products received at dock, brokerage percentage rate, total accumulated brokerage cost.

columns.description: Composite structural key tracking relationship constraints back to vendor contexts.

columns.name: purchase_id

columns.name: purchase_type
columns.description: Classification descriptor tracking operational categories from transactions.

columns.name: purchase_date

columns.name: item_number
